notes: Expected shared-prior misreads, in priority order. (1) THE ELEMENT-GATE CLUSTER: '1 More' only exists if a Wind Code enemy is present, and queen is Fire — so on the Fire control boss the 548.99% rider, the burst's 30.27% ATK, Baton Pass, AND both elemAdvantageDamagePct buffs (13.59 / 25.56) are all damage-inert. A driver pattern-matching 'burst rider' and firing 548.99% per rotation ungated is the biggest over-credit available in this kit; tests need BOTH a Fire-boss zero-assertion and a Wind-boss positive assertion. (2) TIMING OF THE 90.01% DISTRIBUTED BUFF: it must be stageEnter{stage:3} (leads the cast by 30f) so the PRE-FB burst nuke is inside the window — fullBurstEnter keying passes a lazy 'buff exists' test while the nuke silently misses ×1.9001. (3) FIST OF JUSTICE duration: 'continuous and cannot be removed' plus a 'Deactivation condition: When Full Burst ends' line = cast→FB-end window, not permanent; and 'when using Burst Skill' = HER burstCast — the control fixture includes helm as a second B3, so burstCast vs fullBurstEnter genuinely diverge here (uptime roughly halves under alternation) — assert applications are a subset of queen-srcSlot burstCast events. (4) The burst nuke must carry flavor 'distributed' and land pre-FB (no +50%): assert fbMajorApplied false and the ×1.9001 coupling. (5) The 548.99% rider is distributed-flavored and fires at cast, 30f AFTER stage-3 entry, so it IS boosted by the 90.01% window — a test computing its expected value without that factor is wrong on Wind bosses. (6) 'Follow Up' has no source in this kit — it must be unmodeled verbatim, never merged into the 1 More rider (exactly one 548.99% per Wind-boss cast, never two). (7) Baton Pass needs a Persona-state target primitive the schema lacks — inert at scope; assert helm never receives a casterAtkPct grant.
